v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Oránte * sancto Cleménte, appáruit ei Agnus Dei.
text.en: While St. Clement prayed, * there appeared unto him the Lamb of God.

text.la: Non meis méritis * ad vos me misit Dóminus, vestris corónis partícipem fíeri.
text.en: Not for my own merits * hath the Lord sent me unto you, that I may share your crowns.

text.la: Vidi supra montem * Agnum stantem, de sub cuius pede fons vivus emánat.
text.en: I saw on the mountain * the Lamb standing, from beneath whose foot flowed a fountain of living waters.

text.la: De sub cuius pede * fons vivus emánat: flúminis ímpetus lætíficat civitátem Dei.
text.en: From beneath whose foot * a fountain of living waters flowed forth: the stream of the river that maketh glad the city of God.

text.la: Omnes gentes * per gyrum credidérunt Christo Dómino.
text.en: All the nations * round about believed in Christ the Lord.

text.la: Beátus vir, qui suffert tentatiónem: quóniam cum probátus fúerit, accípiet corónam vitæ, quam repromísit Deus diligéntibus se.
text.en: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation; for when he hath been proved, he shall receive a crown of life, which God hath promised to them that love him.

v.en: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree.

r.en: He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

text.la: Dedísti, Dómine, * habitáculum Mártyri tuo Cleménti in mari, in modum templi marmórei angélicis mánibus præparátum: iter præbens pópulo terræ, ut enárrent mirabília tua.
text.en: Lord, * Thou hast given unto thy Martyr Clement a tabernacle in the sea, after the fashion of a temple of marble, builded by the hands of Angels. And Thou givest a way thither unto the people on the land, that they may tell of thy marvellous works.

text.la: Gregem tuum, Pastor ætérne, placátus inténde: et, per beátum Cleméntem Mártyrem tuum atque Summum Pontíficem, perpétua protectióne custódi; quem totíus Ecclésiæ præstitísti esse pastórem.
text.en: Look forgivingly on thy flock, Eternal Shepherd, and keep it in thy constant protection, by the intercession of blessed Clement thy Martyr and Sovereign Pontiff, whom thou didst constitute Shepherd of the whole Church.
